Oliver/Vivek — added technical details below to populate the matrix. I attached a short export guide and example manifest.

What we log (high level):
- Admin console actions: user login attempts (success/fail), role/permission changes, API key/secret create/delete, team invites, OAuth app grants. (Full event payloads + actor metadata)
- Control-plane operations: model deploys/rollbacks, route changes, scaling actions, garbage-collection events.
- Audit trail for key management ops: KMS key creation/rotation events (meta-level, not key material).
- Operator/agent actions: access to customer snapshots, manual snapshots, evidence bundles.
- Request-level telemetry: inference request headers and routing metadata (we redact PII from payloads by default). High-volume inference payloads are sampled for cost; sampling ratio is configurable per-customer and per-route.

Retention defaults and notes:
- Admin activity / control-plane audit: 365 days default (configurable to multi-year for Dedicated/Private).
- Operator session traces & ephemeral agent logs: 90 days by default.
- Raw request traces (full payloads): 30 days default, sampling applies — full retention for flagged incidents.

Export/delivery options we support:
1) On-demand signed tarball: we generate a gzipped tarball (JSONL per-event) with a signed manifest.json and SHA256 checksums. Delivery via S3 signed URL (7-day), or we can push to a provided SFTP.
2) Continuous streaming: secure syslog over TLS to customer endpoint; alternative: Pub/Sub / Kinesis endpoint with TLS + IAM.
3) Direct export to customer-managed S3/GCS with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and object lock if requested.
4) Real-time webhook forwarding for selected event types (low-volume control-plane events).

Constraints and security controls:
- Bundles are encrypted at-rest with our KMS; we can re-encrypt to customer KMS on Dedicated/Private.
- Max single bundle size: 50 GB; for larger exports we chunk and provide multi-part manifest.
- We always include a signed manifest listing events and checksums; signatures use our submission key unless customer requests their own signing key (enterprise).

Sampling guidance:
- Admin/control-plane events: no sampling.
- Inference request traces: recommended sample of 1:1000 for standard telemetry; increase to 1:1 for full forensic capture during incident windows.
